correctness.rationale: For a smooth embedded ring-torus surface R>r>0, sampling density on the meridian is [1+(r/R)cos theta]/2pi, not uniform theta. Independent pair chord D=|X-Y| has m2=2(R²+2r²), m4=(12R^4+52R²r²+39r^4)/2, m6=(40R^6+312R^4r²+516R²r^4+187r^6)/2, obtained from radial A and covariance tensors with central symmetry. The scale-free K(x) increases until x=2/13 then decreases; K(x)=K(y) for x!=y is equivalent to y=(4-9x)/(52x+9), giving exact multiplicity and feasible K range. T(x)=J(x)-6K(x) has derivative 3(51x²+8)/[16(1+2x)^4]>0 and decreasing derivative with inf 59/432 at x=1, proving optimal inverse Lipschitz constant 432/59. Explicit rational ambiguity witness x=1/16,y=55/196 was independently checked. Fresh symbolic independent checks verify K,J,T derivatives and distinct m6. The Hölder 1/2 boundary follows sqrt x; claims concern first three consecutive even chord moments only.
